verdict.rationale: Tailscale establishes persistent mesh connections with device-level auth so users can SSH into saved hosts without re-entering credentials once logged into the tailnet, backed by community reports of seamless SSH access ('just SSH'ed into my boxes...like I'm home'). However, no evidence describes a dedicated one-tap saved-host UI, and community feedback highlights friction like mobile client instability, NAT traversal failures, and DERP fallback that can undermine a truly one-tap seamless experience.
